title: Risk-Gated Adaptive Verification Search
motivation: FAYE-0008 showed that broad micro-calibration of LMR amplitude is not a productive primary direction. FAYE-0009 therefore changes the semantics of selective-search trust: risky pruning and cutoff decisions may be verified before the engine commits to them, while ordinary low-risk nodes retain the fast baseline path.
core_hypothesis: A small fraction of structurally uncertain nodes account for a disproportionate share of harmful selective-search mistakes. Spending extra search only to verify high-impact cutoffs at those nodes can recover tactical and strategic accuracy at lower cost than globally reducing pruning or LMR aggressiveness.

risk_model.description: Compute a compact node-risk/trust classification from search signals that already exist in FayE/Stockfish, with no second network and no dynamic allocation.
candidate_signals: FAYE-0008 root volatility and root best-move churn context
TT bound quality and TT depth relative to current depth
move-order/cutoff evidence already present in search state
risk_model.implementation_constraint: Keep the hot-path payload register-sized and avoid heap allocation, locks, or additional neural-network evaluation.

verification_layer.description: Before accepting selected high-impact pruning/cutoff decisions at high-risk nodes, perform a bounded verification search. Low-risk nodes remain on the promoted FAYE-0008-v2 path.
initial_targets: TT fail-high/fail-low cutoff trust at sufficiently deep non-PV nodes
null-move fail-high verification at risky medium/deep nodes
ProbCut acceptance when local evidence strongly disagrees with the cutoff
non_targets_v1: Do not retune FAYE-0008 LMR constants as part of the primary v1 change
Do not retune FAYE-0008 futility constants as part of the primary v1 change
Do not change NNUE architecture or weights

budget_control.description: Verification must be bounded so the feature cannot recursively explode the tree.
planned_guards: no recursive verification of an already verified decision
at most one verification class activation per node
explicit NPS/node-growth guard before strength testing

why_this_is_major: It changes whether FayE trusts and accepts selective-search cutoffs, rather than only changing a numeric margin.
It introduces a new verification-control layer across multiple pruning mechanisms.
It creates a reusable architecture for future risk-aware pruning, extensions, and search-budget allocation.
It preserves the successful FAYE-0008 controller as the baseline instead of replacing it with another parameter sweep.
development_plan: Implement a compact risk/trust object with instrumentation but no behavior change and verify benchmark parity.
Activate one verification target first, preferably risk-gated null-move verification, to isolate cost and strength.
Only after the first target is understood, add TT/ProbCut verification under the same bounded architecture.
Run correctness gates, perft, deterministic bench, and node/NPS guard before any 600-game match.
Primary strength screen: 600 paired games against official-stockfish/Stockfish master fetched at run start, UHO openings, Threads=1, recorded candidate and Stockfish SHAs.

success_criteria.correctness: UCI/isready and perft gates pass with no search instability or recursion bug.
success_criteria.performance: Target <=3% median NPS regression versus the promoted FAYE-0008-v2 baseline unless node-growth evidence clearly justifies a revised guard.
success_criteria.strength: Use paired 600-game Stockfish-latest evidence as the first strength screen; do not promote from a small or incomplete run.
success_criteria.promotion: Promotion requires a meaningful strength signal plus acceptable compute cost and clean correctness/infrastructure results.

decision_policy: FAYE-0009 is a new major architecture line. Do not continue FAYE-0008 micro-tuning on this branch. Implement and evaluate verification mechanisms incrementally so each causal contribution remains diagnosable.
